questions.question: What did Zechariah see coming out from between two mountains in chapter 6?
What did God instruct concerning Joshua the high priest in Zechariah 6?
options: To carry the ark back into the temple
To build an altar of uncut stones
To crown him, pointing to the coming Branch
To tear down the idols of the nations
questions.answer: To crown him, pointing to the coming Branch

questions.question: Zechariah 6 says the Branch shall build the temple of the LORD and bear royal honor.
Behold, the man whose name is the _____: he shall branch out and build the temple of the LORD.
The four chariots are the four _____ of heaven going out.
